description: Regression proofs: each ReproRunner repro pinned to a real state in which its bug existed (published package, then a dev commit, then a commit of the originating PR). Pull requests prove added or changed entries (known bad MUST FAIL, candidate MUST PASS), the push to dev proves them once on the integrated revision, then the historical comparison retires while the permanent guard stays in the ordinary suites. Maintained by .github/scripts/regression_proof.py; see docs/rules/safety-evidence.md.
